name: BillPayment
description: A bill payment — a payment applied against one or more vendor bills.

update.note: Sparse update; body must include Id and SyncToken.

fields.name: Id
fields.description: System-assigned unique identifier for the bill payment. Read-only; required (with SyncToken) for update and delete.

fields.name: SyncToken
fields.description: Version number of the object. Read-only and system-assigned; required on update to ensure the latest version is being modified.

fields.name: VendorRef
fields.description: Reference to the vendor receiving the payment. Required for create. Specify the Vendor.Id in value.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced Vendor object.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced vendor.

fields.name: PayType
fields.description: Type of payment. Required for create. Determines which payment detail object (CheckPayment or CreditCardPayment) must be supplied.

fields.name: TotalAmt
fields.description: Total amount of the transaction. Required for create; must equal the sum of the Line.Amount values applied to the bills. Returned in responses as the computed total.

fields.name: Line
fields.description: The line items of the bill payment. Each line links the payment to a vendor bill (or other payable transaction) via LinkedTxn. Required for create; at least one line must be present.

attributes.name: Amount
attributes.description: The amount of the payment applied to the linked transaction(s) on this line.

attributes.name: LinkedTxn
attributes.description: Array of references to the transactions this payment line is applied against (typically Bills, or other payable transactions).

attributes.name: TxnId
attributes.description: The Id of the linked transaction (e.g., the Bill being paid).

attributes.name: TxnType
attributes.description: The type of the linked transaction. For a standard bill payment this is 'Bill'.

attributes.name: TxnLineId
attributes.description: The Id of the specific line within the linked transaction, when applicable.

attributes.name: LineEx
attributes.description: Internal use; extension element carrying additional name/value metadata for the line.

attributes.name: any
attributes.description: Collection of name/value pairs for internal use.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name key of the extension element.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Value of the extension element.

fields.name: CheckPayment
fields.description: Payment detail when PayType is Check. Conditionally required: must be present when PayType = Check. Mutually exclusive with CreditCardPayment.

attributes.name: BankAccountRef
attributes.description: Reference to the bank account from which the check is drawn. Required within CheckPayment when PayType = Check. Specify the Account.Id in value.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced bank Account object.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced bank account.

attributes.name: PrintStatus
attributes.description: Printing status of the check.

fields.name: CreditCardPayment
fields.description: Payment detail when PayType is CreditCard. Conditionally required: must be present when PayType = CreditCard. Mutually exclusive with CheckPayment.

attributes.name: CCAccountRef
attributes.description: Reference to the credit card account used for the payment. Required within CreditCardPayment when PayType = CreditCard. Specify the Account.Id in value.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced credit card Account object.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced credit card account.

fields.name: APAccountRef
fields.description: Reference to the Accounts Payable (A/P) account against which the bill payment is applied. For companies with multiple A/P accounts, this specifies which one; defaults to the company A/P account otherwise.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced A/P Account object.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced A/P account.

fields.name: DocNumber
fields.description: Reference number for the transaction (e.g., check number). If not supplied and auto-numbering is enabled, QBO may assign one. Max 21 characters.

fields.name: TxnDate
fields.description: The date of the bill payment transaction. Defaults to the current date if not supplied.

fields.name: PrivateNote
fields.description: User-entered private memo/note for the transaction, visible only internally. Max 4000 characters.

fields.name: CurrencyRef
fields.description: Reference to the currency of all amounts on the transaction. Applicable only when multicurrency is enabled. Specify a three-letter ISO 4217 code in value.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code (e.g., 'USD').

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Full name of the currency.

fields.name: ExchangeRate
fields.description: The exchange rate between the transaction currency and the home currency as of TxnDate. Applicable only when multicurrency is enabled.

fields.name: ProcessBillPayment
fields.description: When true, the bill payment is processed electronically through QuickBooks (e.g., online bill pay) rather than being recorded only. Defaults to false.

fields.name: TransactionLocationType
fields.description: The account location, used for transactions subject to France-style tax localization. Valid values depend on the company locale.

fields.name: DepartmentRef
fields.description: Reference to a Department (location/class), used to track the transaction against a department when location tracking is enabled. Specify the Department.Id in value.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced Department object.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced department.

fields.name: MetaData
fields.description: System-maintained descriptive metadata about the object (creation and last-update timestamps). Read-only.

attributes.name: CreateTime
attributes.description: Time the object was created (read-only).

attributes.name: LastUpdatedTime
attributes.description: Time the object was last updated (read-only).

fields.name: domain
fields.description: Internal use. Identifies the originating product/domain; always 'QBO'. Read-only.

fields.name: sparse
fields.description: Indicates whether the object is a full or sparse representation. When true on update, only the supplied fields are modified. Read-only in responses.

specialOperations.name: Void a billpayment
specialOperations.description: Voids an existing BillPayment object via a sparse update; the transaction remains active but all amounts and quantities are zeroed, all lines are cleared, and the string 'Voided' is prepended to BillPayment.PrivateNote (prepended to existing text if present).

queryParams.name: operation
queryParams.description: Must be set to 'update' to perform the void via a sparse update operation.

queryParams.name: include
queryParams.description: Must be set to 'void' to void the BillPayment object.

pathParams.name: realmID
pathParams.description: The company ID (realm) for the QuickBooks Online company.

specialOperations.note: Void is performed as a sparse update (POST to the base billpayment endpoint) with query params operation=update&include=void; request body must include sparse=true plus a minimum of BillPayment.Id and BillPayment.SyncToken.
